nom: Philosophy Dose of Wisdom Bouncy Skin Reactivating Serum

avis.texte: The eye cream did nothing for my puffy & dark under eye area. It did smooth out my fine lines around my eyes but the moisturizing did not last long as my lines came back after a couple of hours.
This is a lovely serum that makes your complexion look absolutely radiant.
I used it for two weeks, after a few hours the residue of the cream peels off. I did not like it.
Wonderful way to wake up your skin and make it glow. It goes on very smoothly it makes my skin feel very silky!

This is a very nice eye cream that does a great job of depuffing and giving eyes that well rested look. Dark circles do look less pronounced if used consistently. It's a very lightweight cream that absorbs well,

I originally tried this product as part of a gift set and have returned to buy it several times. I've been using Philosophy products for over 20 years and trust them to deliver quality products that live up to their claims.
Im 57 and love how this product goes on and feels. It makes my puffiness and dark circles go away. I also chose this product because it is cleaner then a lot of products on the market.
I am definitely happy with this product; it leaves my face looking luminous and full of life. I can use it both morning and night—I feel and look radiant!.

avis.titre: Dark circle eye brightening eye cream
avis.texte: This luxurious eye cream dramatically enhances my under-eye area, visibly reducing fine lines and creating a luminous, refreshed appearance. The lightweight formula instantly brightens and smooths my delicate eye contours, leaving my skin looking more radiant.

avis.titre: I love Philosophy products.  I've been a customer.
avis.texte: I'm really disappointed with this product. It absolutely does nothing. It's expensive.

avis.titre: Only if Philosophy were more wise…
avis.texte: I am 65, my 43 year old daughter and 19 year old granddaughter recommended this since they use it and highly recommended for dark circles under eyes. I was skeptical since I am older. After just a few uses I feel I can already see a difference, my dark circles under my eyes have brightened and only after a couple of uses! Reason for not giving Dose of Wisdom Brighting eye cream 5 stars, is that I feel Philosophy should be more WISE and not charge so much for such a small container. I'll keep an EYE open for a sale.
I just started using this product and love it. It makes my skin feel and look much younger than I am.
I have used this for over a year and feel it helps with my dark circles under my eyes. I feel it has helped!
I really enjoyed this eye cream! My eyes felt much brighter and less puffy. Great for those mornings when you didn't sleep well. Blended well under my makeup!
After applying and allowing it to dry the eyecream peeled off my face.
Really love the texture this gives my skin, and can't wait to see long term results

Received thisinitially as a sample product and thought just another serum. I was so wrong! This serum goes on easily and absorbs quickly; a small amount will do. My skin is soft, smooth and really seems " bouncy" as claimed. I love, love, love this product!
This is awesome. It makes my skin feel and look younger and more supple. My skin drinks it in and it immediately feels nourished.My makeup seems to look better too.
I have tried many products from other companies. I love this product. I can see results and am so pleased. Thank you. Philosophy for helping me achieve my skin goalsm

This serum is really amazing. I received a sample and I saw a difference immediately. My skin has a glow and the texture improved completely. I had to purchase the 3oz bottle because I need this in my life!!!
I got a sample of this serum and was disappointed when I ran out. It made my skin feel smooth and moisturized, and didn't hurt my very sensitive skin.
I really like this serum. Can see an instant smoothing and 'bounciness'. 😁 I also love the scent!
This is a good product and makes my face feel good. Doesn't dry my skin, makes it feel soothe and hydrated. I use it with other products to help with my drying skin due to the cold winter days
Good eye cream but haven't noticed a dramatic difference for me.
I haven't used it very long but I like this product it's very lightweight.

avis.titre: Dark Circles Will Not Go Away!
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product, but after 5 weeks of applying product to the dark circles under my eyes, I see barely noticeable improvement, maybe less than 5%, if even that much. Definitely NOT worth the expense and was wasted money for me. I am a longtime Philosophy user, but I cannot recommend this product.

avis.titre: simple, yet calming eye cream helps to keep dryne
avis.texte: Incredible! Feels soft, absorbs easily, and actually makes my eyes look awake without any heaviness. Ticks all the boxes for a dreamy eye product. Hydrating and lightweight, it smooths my under-eyes and keeps them looking fresh.
I think this serum works well for all skin types and it doesn't make my skin irritated.
Love the way this feels going on and how smooth my moisturizer feels going on after. Has become a staple for me!
This product may work but not my favorite. It is a bit drying and it seems to evaporate quickly in the bottle as well as my face.

avis.titre: An eye cream that actually delivers on its promise
avis.texte: This eye cream is the first and only eye cream that actually works. It does not only make my under eyes appear de-puffed and brighter. It has actually made my dark circles less noticeable over time, even when I have no makeup on. Thanks Philosophy. I am customer for life.

Absolute must have! It really does bring your dull skin back to life. This was my introduction into philosophy and it did not disappoint! A little goes a long way so it is well worth the price, and it puts the bouncy right back into your skin while also shrinking your pores!! I love this!!

avis.titre: Dose of Wisdom Bouncy Skin Reactivating Serum
avis.texte: Really wanted to love this serum because I was told it's scientifically proven to make a difference. Unfortunately it has a fragrance that made my sinuses begin to run. Also, I have sensitive skin and this made my skin burn and itch.

Originally I got this tem as a free sample but I quickly saw what a great product it was and ordered more! It makes my skin feel and look more youthful with every use. I dont like anything that is heavy, oily, or greasy so I was so surprised by how this goes on so weightlessly and I don't feel it after I put it on!!!

Love the pump style packaging . Used this daily for 12 weeks . Didn't notice any positive changes in my dark circles and find undereye lines . Wouldn't recommend. Will not purchase again . Highly disappointed due to the price.
I got a little bottle in a sampler pack and HAD to buy the big bottle. I love the scent and my skin feels lovely and bouncy after a short time of using it.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product again
avis.texte: I have been reading about facial serums. It seems that their usage is alleged to help firm skin, reduction of fine lines and wrinkles. It's to be utilized with s moisturizer. This particular serum has not irritated my sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling soft.

I've been a philosophy gal for a long time! I switched to this serum as my skin matured, and I have not been disappointed! Goes on smooth, my skin drinks it in, great results. I layer it with my moisturizer, and my skin is supple and beautiful!

What a pleasure to run into a product that actually tries to back up its claims! The effectiveness of this this cream is something that I will be talking to family and friends about. The scent was light to my sensibility and didn't bring on a migraine at all which was a complete health must! I can say that this made the value worth it 100 fold! I would definitely recommend this product to family and friends to do what it claims it will do.

Let's talk about my fav brand and best eye cream from them,this is Philosophy dose of wisdom dark circle brightning eye cream. As single mom for me sleep is really hard thing. I started using this eye cream last year and still on top. It contains Vitamin C and Hyaluronic acid,vitamin c helps to brighten dark skin under eyes and hyaluronic acid moisturizes skin. It also helps to reduce puffiness under my eyes. If you have same problems you really need to try it🤎

I received this product for free from Influenster and brand(s) in exchange for my honest review. My first impression of this product was the smooth texture and clean scent. This made my skin feel really good! Did a great job moisturizing and made a great base for makeup. Really good!
I am very pleased with the coverage of this product. I will be purchasing more as time goes on.
After using this product for a week I noticed a huge difference in my under eye bags. I'm happy to say that this product didn't break me out because I have extremely sensitive skin.
I love this product! It makes my skin feel firm and younger looking. I would recommend it.
Dose of wisdom is a great product that I like to use after the pore minimizing serum and before the hope in a jar moisturizer. Adds that extra layer of bounce, glow and firmness.
Light cream for under eyes, just dab it on lightly and your eyes will perknup.
This works sooo well!! The packaging is cute! Its expensive for such a small amount of product. It is very effective and helps my eye area look brighter.

Worked pretty well for me, I had really dark and deep circles and it actually helped brighten up my eyes a lot. You couldn't tell before , but after using this and applying makeup it's like I'm a brand new person lol packing is great and travel friendly the lid locks and it doesn't have a strong scent that would bother you. Ingredients are noted to be friendly
I like the feel & look of my skin. A nice & easy application when I don't choose to wear any makeup

I got this as a free mini sample in one of those "add $75 to you bag and get these items free" deals. This was an item I've been really wanting to try!! BUT…it does not pair well with the rest of my skin care routine. After applying this, I would apply my face lotion (cerave) and then my tinted sunscreen (supergoop mineral matte screen) and it pilled really bad around my eyes. I thought maybe I didn't wait long eniugh for it to absorb, maybe I used too much, maybe i should only use it at night instead if the morning….none of the changed worked, it still pilled. There's no way I was gonna change all my face products just so I could continue to use this one. Glad it was a free sample!
I've been using this for several months now, and around my eyes seem more hydrated & not as tired looking. The formula absorbs nicely, and my skin feels silky.
Great price and samples of Dolce&Gabbana Parfum are very nice scents!
I wear this under my moisturizer every morning! Helps with fine lines and wrinkles better than anything else I've tried for years. Made noticeable difference in fine lines around eyes and mouth area.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again! I love it!!!
avis.texte: This was recommended for eye care from Jackie and I'm obsessed! I will be purchasing more for Christmas gifts!

Love holiday kits especially when it includes a product that you love or really wanna try. This moisturizer is amazing and makes my skin feel super soft, hydrated and glowy. I also love the value of this kit. The price of the full size moisturizer alone is the same price as this kit, which also includes a sample of the serum and a mini moisturizer, which is perfect for travel.
I've only used this a short time but I believe I am seeing brighter and smoother skin on my face. A tiny amount speaks easily over my face.
This was a nicely moisturizing formula. Did not cause me any irritation and sat well under makeup. Did not make a difference in my hereditary dark circles but then again nothing does

I received this free for review from influencer. This is a nice set. I noticed that after using the eye brighter for awhile my eyes looked less tired. It doesn't have an overwhelming scent which is nice. The packaging is simple and nice.

avis.titre: My face feels and looks better!
avis.texte: I enjoyed using this product. After using this product for a while, my face feels and looks so refreshed. I look like I feel better. I didn't think my eyes looking better would overall help as much as it did. Also, I thought the set was cute. It would make a great present.
I like how the scent is very little to this. Im seeing my darkness go away slowly after using this product, I usually apply before bed and in the mornings. It also leaves my skin smooth.

This serum is worth it all day. I tried it in store and it had the rarer mark of a good quality product that really hydrates many layers into the skin, which is a huge deal for someone with drier skin like myself, especially in the winter. If you pair this with the hope in a jar exfoliating cream (rub it on and the dead skin sloughs right off with the cream). This serum/exfoliate combo is better than average facials. *This isnt the duo exfoliating package that has the scrub and Activating cream i dont want to confuse people. These are separate items. I also use the décolletage cream as well and i use the miracle pump for that area (not the jars those are too heavy/greasy for me). This one looks like a bottle of conditioner but its for your chest. Im pleasantly surprised by these particular products from the philosophy line. Those are the standouts imo!

avis.titre: Makes my eyes look and feel better
avis.texte: This does of wisdom by Philosophy is definitely a very good product. I have been using it for over a month now and I have definitely seen a difference in the appearance and feel of my eyes. The skin around my eyes feels tighter and they definitely do not look as tired as they have in the past. The morning application makes me feel more awake and confident in going about my day. You just need a tiny drop when applying so sometimes it is easy to over do it, but all in all a very good product.

This is a cute packaged gift set. I like how it even has the gift tag image to fill in on the box. It contains a larger glass jar and a smaller plastic jar (great for travel or throwing in a gym bag) of Hope in a Jar. This is a nice basic moisturizer. It does have a fragrance but not too strong of one and it is pleasant. My skin feels moisturized after using it. It's pleasant to use and absorbs pretty quickly. You also get a small tube of Dose of Wisdom which is a serum. I like the serum but am not sold. I feel others have made more of a noticeable difference. Overall these are two good products and a cute skincare set if looking for a gift.

I have tried a few over-the-counter eye creams to reduce the appearance of dark circles. I use other Philosophy products and decided to try their Dose of Wisdom Eye Cream. After using the product for a few weeks, I see results, and the dark circles are less noticeable.

avis.titre: Pick one product over the other
avis.texte: When you hear the brand philosophy, you know it's going to be a good product. I loved the package duo to help with brightening your under eye as well has hydrating your face with the rejuvenating serum. They both have a small scent but nothing over powering. As far as results are concerned, I loved one product over the other. The serum is incredible. Saw a difference in my skin in days. The eye cream, I wasn't over the moon impressed. I didn't see any change in brightness or over all healthier under eye. So for the package duo and the price, I would buy just the serum and by pass the under-eye cream. Serum is a game changer!

I really liked the Hope moisturizer in this set - it was my favorite product. It was lightweight enough to wear in the morning before putting makeup on. I have very dry skin, and while it definitely helped, I still needed a little more help to get through the day. The scent was very minimal which was nice but pleasant. I didn't have enough of the bouncy skin serum to use to notice a difference, but it felt nice to put on and didn't irritate my skin!

avis.titre: Miraxle Face Hydration + Reduced Dark Circles!
avis.texte: Bright and Bouncy Skin! Love this combo set with a hydrating, reactivating face serum + eye cream for dark under eye circles. They're both so light and smooth to applying. A little bit goes a long way too! My dark under eye circles are noticeably lighter. The serum makes my face more even and balanced. These will be my new go-to face products moving forward! Love, Love! Definitely give it a try!

This philosophy gift set is a great way to try a few different products. It includes both the hope in a jar and dose of wisdom. Both are great products for moisturizing and smoothing skin. I also like how it includes a small hope in a jar that you can easily throw in your purse. Overall, I really like these philosophy products! I recommend giving them a try!

These 2 products are worth the hype! The eye cream gets absorbed quickly and leaves the under eye area looking rested. The skin formula has a pleasant scent and makes my skin feel refreshed. I would def recommend both products!

This is such a great lightweight smooth cream that is slightly scented. It is a great product to put on at night and let it sit in, this product is always in my travel case so I can keep firm no bags under my eyes when I am jet lagged and need it the most

First of all, the packaging of this set is just so cute, the sizing perfect as stocking stuffers, and the quality of the bottles and pumps are amazing! I love the pump on the eye cream and how it dispenses the perfect amount for my under eye areas. The eye cream doesn't dramatically brighten my dark circles but it is so moisturizing and comfortable to use, doesn't cause any irritation after using it for almost a month. The bouncy skin serum smells like a flower garden in the spring, very beautiful, it is a thicker serum but goes on smooth, a bit sticky but works well under moisturizer. I especially love the pump design of the serum bottle because it has a flat cap that pops up versus having the bulb for their dispenser, it is my favorite! Overall a wonderful set and I would love to explore other options from this brand for stocking stuffers in the upcoming holidays.

I love the smaller size of these products which makes it easier to travel with them. I have been loving the way these make my skin feel, I don't feel like my skin is weighed down after using them. My skin is feeling softer and I have noticed more a more even complexion and my eyes don't look quite as dark and dull.

This is such a beautiful gift set! The moisturizing cream is amazing for dry skin. I have acne-prone, sensitive dry skin and this has done nothing but wonders for my skin as well approach colder months. The formula is rich and creamy, but doesn't clog my pores or cause breakouts. I've been really impressed with how it preforms and plan to purchase more in the future. The set is really nice because it also includes a travel size I can take with me when I go on trips. Highly recommend to anyone who needs a moisture boost & has sensitive or dry skin!!
I like their face lotion. However I wish all 3 packages weren't exactly the same. The smell is subtle and nice. It works well for hydration and makes my face soft. Would recommend.

This isn't the first product i've tried from philosophy, I love and use their purity face every day. And once again i've found another product i really like. I love how the eye cream feels thick and hydrating but still thin enough to wear under makeup and i've found it enhances the effectiveness of concealer. Although i will say the serum is not suitable for wearing under makeup as it pills. But, the packaging of the serum is a 10/10 I love the fact that it locks too!

I received these products to test in return for my honest review. It came in a nice packaging with 2 moisturizers and a serum. I have been using both as directed, and my skin feels so soft. I will warn you that it has a sunburn warning on it. Fine for me, I use sun screen daily. You use these products am and pm. Definitely see and feel a difference. Love that is comes with a smaller moisturizer as well for travel.

avis.titre: The best moisturizing serum for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: Philosophy dose of wisdom bouncy skin reactivating serum is my absolute favorite serum. As someone who breaks out from everything, this product does not do this. I suffer from rosacea and this does not burn my skin and provides a little extra hydration. It also smells amazing and comes in a glass bottle with dropper.

I received a philosophy 3 pc moisture icon for hydrated , smooth & radiant skin from influenster for free to try and leave my honest review. It's a good choice for a Christmas present. This set came with: Hope in a jar for a smooth glow multi-tasking moisturizer. Hope In A Jar Smooth-Glow Multi-Tasking Moisturizer is clinically proven to help treat dehydrated skin, uneven texture, wrinkles and dullness. This supercharged formula delivers instant and long-term visible results. HOW TO USE:• Use the hydrating face moisturizer in the morning and in the evening on clean, dry skin. For all skin types. Immediate positive impact on skin: clinically proven to deliver instant and long-lasting hydration for up to 24 hour, immediate clinical improvement in skin texture, fine lines and wrinkles sustained positive impact on skin. Also came with dose of wisdom bouncy skin reactivate Serum with vitamin C, hyaluronic acid and glycolic_acid. renews skin by removing accumulated dead skin while increasing skin's ability to rehydrate and support its natural hyaluronic acid for long-lasting deep hydration and smoother, radiant skin. serum: this daily facial serum acts as an energetic jumpstart for the skin, reactivating & restoring healthy bounce through deep hydration and collagen support. use in the morning and in the evening on clean, dry skin. serum: apply to clean, dry skin. use am/pm.
What an amazing set! Both products are luxurious and absorb wonderfully! I think this a great value for someone looking to treat themselves or looking for a great set for someone!

I have been using this product for the past few months holy grill I think everybody needs to have this moisturizer in their kit under eye cream. I highly recommended the scent. It doesn't even have a strong scent ingredients are pretty clean and I've gotten my entire family onto it run and go get it. ￼
The feeling of the cream and serum are nice and hydrating. I haven't really noticed a difference in my skin than the other moisturizers I've used

I absolutely loved testing this Philosphy skin care duo in exchange for my honest review. This skin care holiday gift set has a cute box and the packaging perks don't end there. Both the serum and eye cream are in simple and attractive packaging, in clear/white glass bottles with black tops. I love the elegant yet classic style of Philosophy's font and packaging styles! On to the actual products. I always use eye cream at night and serum AM and PM after washing and before moisturizer. I love that the eye cream is unscented and not overly thick. A little goes a long way to moisture crows eye area! In a couple weeks of use my eyes look brighter for sure! The serum is perfect. A slight scent but it's clean and natural, almost herbal or faintly floral in a really nice way. It's the perfect viscosity and compliments my skincare routine with no acne or redness. I love that the serum doesn't cause any tackiness, tight skin, or irritation. So amazing!
I love Philosophy products & have used them for years. This product makes my skin look so young! At 66, I was was recently mistaken for being under 55!! Ski

It was a joy to use the products from this set especially the dose of wisdom reactivating serum. It felt good on my skin and left my skin smooth and bouncy. You apply the dose of wisdom as the first step. You get two hope in a jar moisturizers one travel size that's in a plastic jar and one full size in a glass jar. The moisturizer feels nice but isn't the best, for my skin. It's ok for daytime and maybe summer. But it wasn't moisturizing enough for me and when used at night, when I woke up my skin looked and felt dry. These products have no scent by the way, so they would be nice for people with sensitive skin or people with a sensitivity to fragrance.

The Philosophy Moisture Icon 3-Piece Set is a skincare treat! Each product delivers intense hydration without feeling greasy, leaving my skin soft and refreshed. The cleanser is gentle yet effective, the moisturizer absorbs beautifully, and the serum adds a perfect glow. A fantastic set for anyone needing a boost in their skincare routine!
The philosophy, three piece best selling moisture icon for hydrated, smooth and radiant. Skin holiday gift set is perfect. The packaging is so neat and it smells so good. ￼
I love this philosophy it makes my face so soft. I love that it helped my dark circles under my eyes. It sure did brighten them up. I love how the top works. It is a great product.

I'm very new to the serum game, but this product does exactly what it claims to! You can watch it brighten the skin as you apply. You also don't need a full pump per eye as the canister suggests. I wish it plumped a little more, but that's it!

avis.titre: Perfect combination for skincare, ensuring a healthy appe...
avis.texte: These products are perfect for my face! If you're looking for a flawless combination for skincare, this is exactly what you need. Give them a try, and you won't regret it!

I've been using Philosophy's Dose of Wisdom Reactivating Serum morning and night for a few weeks now, and I'm absolutely in love! This serum has truly transformed my skin. The noticeable firming and plumping effects are incredible. My skin feels more youthful and resilient. I've also noticed a significant improvement in my skin tone. The vitamin C in the formula has brightened my complexion and evened out any discolouration. The patented Vitality Booster and hyaluronic acid work wonders in hydrating and plumping my skin. I wake up each morning with a refreshed and dewy complexion. I highly recommend this serum to anyone looking to improve their skin's appearance. It's a game-changer!

avis.titre: Lovely little gift set for skincare lovers
avis.texte: As someone who loves Philosophy skincare, this gift set is absolutely perfect. This set comes with a 2oz. Hope In A Jar Moisturizer, a travel size of the moisturizer, plus a sample size of Dose of Wisdom Skin Reactivating Serum. I have used the moisturizer before and getting this as a gift in the colder months is always a blessing for my skin!
This gift s t was the perfect size for the value. It doesn't have a scent and is great for sensitive skin! Would make and awesome stocking stuffer or gift for the holidays!

I've wanted to try skin care from Philosophy for a long time and now I finally got my hands on Philosophy 2-pc duo for bright eyes & bouncy skin skincare holiday gift set. The packaging looks very modest, but personally I would notice it on the store shelves not because it has a flashy appearance, but on the contrary, because it looks restrained and original, as they say - a good thing does not need advertising. In my opinion, the packaging is perfect for a gift. The set contains eye cream and face serum. It should be used twice a day, in the morning and in the evening on pre-cleansed and dry skin. I did not feel any smell from the eye cream, and the face serum has a very weak and unobtrusive smell, which is very light and fresh and will not "suffocate" you at night, just the way I like it. The texture of the eye cream is medium density and one press on the dispenser tip is just enough to apply the cream to the area around the eye. The texture of the face serum is lighter, it is absorbed very quickly and therefore I need two portions from the pipette to apply to the entire skin of the face. After application, there are no unpleasant feelings of tightness, stickiness, a feeling of "film" or excessive oiliness. The eye cream is applied quite easily, does not stretch the skin and does not cause tears, I apply it with my ring finger with light patting movements and it is absorbed in 30 seconds. The face serum is absorbed even faster, does not leave marks, but only a light pleasan

These 3 pieces set are great for traveling when you don't want to bring bulk, full-size items. The hope in a jar is great if your skin feels dry and needs some moisture. I applied at night and woke up to wonderful soft skin. I like that it left a nice glow like I just came from a soa treatment. The product itself is very lightweight and not oily at all.
Such a good product and totally worth the price! I see such an improvement on my fine line and wrinkles! I would recommend this product to anyone who needs a little help in the wrinkle department!

avis.titre: Did not work at all. Peels horribly
avis.texte: I hate that I wasted almost $60 on this product. Ive had bad dark circles under my eyes ever since doing chemo and I was willing to spend the money for improvement but this was a horrible let down. Not only did it not work but after a hour of wearing it the product started to peel off and get gunky. I'll never buy this product again.
Great serum. I love the texture of my skin after using this product.

This is first time trying any products from Philosophy. This set is really cute! I'm also really impressed with the moisturizer! It's thick and rich; I've been using at night. I also like the serum but haven't found myself reaching for it as much.

This set includes bouncy skin reactivating serum and dark circle eye cream. The serum has a lightweight, gel-like texture that feels refreshing upon application. It absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving no greasy or sticky residue. The eye cream has a rich yet lightweight texture that spreads easily around the delicate eye area. It absorbs quickly, leaving the skin feeling soft and hydrated without any greasy or heavy residue. Since it's a holiday gift set, its sizes are very small and I can't fully tell there are any changes on my skin. Overall, it's still a great set to try before you decide to buy a full size.

avis.titre: Best products for you skincare routine
avis.texte: Dose of Wisdom gift set is packed with powerful ingredients that visibly reduce the appearance of fine lines, dark circles, and puffiness. The product is lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my under-eye area and skin feeling/looking refreshed and radiant. It's my #1 product in my skincare routine.

It's lightweight on skin and it does not feel greasy at all. The ingredients are great. I feel its good quality for price but I wish container was bigger. It has slight loving fragrance but not too strong. I would highly recommend it to anyone.
Loving this set. The serum is nice and smells good. Left my skin feeling nice. Nice glass bottle. The bright eyes feels nice, haven't noticed any changes yet.

Just as the title suggests. After using the sample, it fulfilled what I was looking for. My age is 67 (loud & kinda proud). I'm not expecting miracles because I was a sun-worshipper & cleaned my face with warm tap water & a cloth. But I know what I know & am enjoying this product.

The packaging for this gift set is nice. The combo for under the eyes is effective and price point is worth it! This product is unscented which is a plus! Ingredients are great as the brand makes great products. I do recommend this as a gift option for the Holidays. I received this product free from Influenster for my honest review.
So far I'm loving this set. Good quality products and rich in moisturizing properties. I like the dispenser of each product. Would recommend philosophy

avis.titre: A lovely present for your girls
avis.texte: I love this package! There is 1 full size, 1 small size of moisturizer and 1 small size serum! The small sizes are suitable for traveling! It keeps my skin moisturized for the whole night! My skin is sensitive and I can use this well

I received a sample of this with one of my orders and decided to try it out and OMG I instantly saw a difference it instantly brightened my under eyes with just one use and im a person who don't believe eye creams work. i will be buying the full size
What a beautiful gift set! Love the packaging and the smell! Love that it comes with 3 different products so that you are able to try all three and see which you like!
The texture of this serum is silky, very absorbable and has a strong hydrating effect. The vc extract helps to improve the appearance of wrinkles and gives the skin a more plumped up appearance.

The gift set packaging is so cute and I just LOVE the smell of these products! After using the lotion and serum for only 2 days I woke up with my skin feeling more hydrated and firm! I'll definitely be ordering the full size products!

The packaging makes it easy to get both products out of bottle. No strong scents. If you are sensitive to that these products will not have a strong smell. Light formula and absorbs quickly into skin. Perfect size to fit in makeup bag
LOVEEE THESE PRODUCTS!!! Great hydration and moisturizer! Super cute packaging, very clean!! Great ingredients and smells amazinggg too!!

avis.titre: Great  duo for skin and eyes
avis.texte: I received this item for free from influenster in exchange for my honest review. I am excited to add this duo to my nighttime routine. I was looking for an eye care product mostly. I obviously haven't been able to see a major difference right away with dark circles but hoping for some brightness. The eye cream doesn't have a noticeable scent but the skin serum does. I haven't broken out from the products. Both sink into the skin quickly.

First of all, this is the cutest packaging for gifting! Love that it includes a little gift tag in the back. Now on to the product - I've been including both serums as part of my nighttime routine for a little over a week now, and I'm really happy with the results. My skin feels so nourished and "bouncy." I didn't know what to expect with this. This is a great set. The products weren't heavily fragranced, and didn't irritate my sensitive skin. Both products added a bounce and healthy sheen to my skin. The packaging would make a nice, hugging end Holiday gift.

Beautiful and chic packaging, I loved the product, I already knew the brand and I literally love it, the skin looks beautiful and radiant, the smell is good and the raw material is excellent. Great Christmas gift.

I'm always on the lookout for anything to help with my dry skin. This serum is so rich feeling and absorbs quick into my skin! I use it morning and night along with the eye cream. I will repurchase these!

This gift set is perfect! The value is there, the products are effective, and the packaging is cute! I will be getting a few of these to give out around the holidays. My skin really loves philosophy products so I feel confident gifting their products.

I received this Bright Eyes and Bouncy Skin Holiday Set for free from Philosophy and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. Both products have a really nice and light fresh clean scent. As light as it is, there's a calmness to the scent. The Bouncy Skin Reactivating Serum comes in a dropper bottle with a twist top. The texture of the serum is milky and has a bit of thickness to it. The serum absorbed quickly and was slightly tacky, but that feeling went away once the serum was dry. My skin is left feeling and looks very hydrated and refreshed once this serum is applied. I don't have too many lines, but I have noticed some improvement in the smoothness of my forehead and lines around my eyes, more so than on areas such as smile lines. The Bright Eyes Eye Cream is a thick eye cream, and a little goes a long way. I feel a bit of coolness when I first apply the eye cream, and I really like how soft it felt on my undereyes. This cream has definitely helped with puffiness and texture around my eyes, and so far, I've noticed a slight improvement in my undereye darkness. I do have a couple of dark patches near my eyes, and the darkness has improved on those patches with the Bright Eyes Cream significantly. This set would make a good gift for someone into skincare or these items specifically. The packaging is cute enough where you would just need to add a bow. It even has a To/From tag on the box. I could see myself purchasing these items again.
